$note: Thresholds and exemptions for format-changed.mjs and smells.mjs.
$formatExcludeNote: Skipped by format-changed: tools/bundle.mjs cannot parse split exports.
$allowedNumbersNote: Numeric literals that never count as magic numbers.
$minDuplicateTokensNote: Shortest repeated run of normalized tokens, in whole statements.
$maxFunctionLinesNote: Longest function, in source lines from its first to its last line.
$maxNestingNote: Deepest block nesting (if, loop, switch, try) inside one function.
$minRepeatedStringsNote: Uses of one string in a file's functions that count as repeated.
